title: fix(plugin-form): a sectioned object-form clears after a save on submitBehavior continue and resetOnSuccess

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_
Fixes #27602

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`object-form` 的分组(sections)表单现在与平铺表单读同一条「保存后清空」规则,`submitBehavior: { kind: 'continue' }` 或新建表单上的 `resetOnSuccess: true` 在保存后清空表单。
- 为什么改:分组表单原先不带这条规则,「保存并新增下一条」保存后仍留着上一条的值,用户再存一次就是一条近似重复记录;平铺表单早已正确。
- 风险与回滚:风险低,只是把平铺路径已有的同一表达式提成一个常量,两条路径共读;两个键都没声明的表单行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` 的 `resetOnSubmit` 常量及分组路径 `form` 节点新加的一行;再看 `ObjectForm.resetOnSubmit-27602.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.resetOnSubmit-27602.test.tsx`,预期 6 个测试全绿(平铺、分组各 3 个)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`SimpleObjectForm` renders an `object-form` block through one of two `form` nodes: the flat one, and the sectioned one (explicit `sections`, or sections derived from the object's field groups). Only the flat node carried `resetOnSubmit`, so a sectioned "save and add another" form kept the saved record's values while the same declaration on a flat form cleared it.

The rule is now one named const, `resetOnSubmit`, declared once beside `formLayout` and read by both nodes:

```ts
const resetOnSubmit = schema.submitBehavior?.kind === 'continue'
  || (!schema.submitBehavior && schema.resetOnSuccess && schema.mode === 'create');
```

The expression is unchanged from the flat path's; the flat node now reads the const instead of its own copy, and the sectioned node gains the same key. Nothing else resets the form imperatively: the `continue` arm of the submit-behaviour switch is a no-op whose comment already defers to `resetOnSubmit`, and the form renderer's single `form.reset()` call after a successful submit is the only reader.

Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch.

## Tests

`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.resetOnSubmit-27602.test.tsx` renders the same block flat and sectioned (`describe.each` over both paths) and saves `name: 'Alpha'`, reading the field once the submit button is enabled again (the form disables it for the whole submit, reset included):

- `submitBehavior: { kind: 'continue' }` clears, on both paths;
- `resetOnSuccess: true` on a create form clears, on both paths;
- neither key declared keeps `Alpha`, on both paths.

**Ablation**, run once, on the committed fix (`97c6b181`), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The mutation deleted the sectioned node's `resetOnSubmit,` line (anchor 1 → 0, blob `1fa7f7aa0930` → `5c7ae6369dbf`). Result: the two sectioned clear cases went red and the other four stayed green (`Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`). The restore was verified with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test imports `./ObjectForm` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- Not reproduced in a browser; the defect and the fix are both measured at the component layer, through the same `ObjectForm` the block registers.
- Lint on the two touched files: 0 errors. The warnings are `no-explicit-any`; the new test's four come from the same `as any` schema and data-source casts its sibling `ObjectForm.showReset-27247.test.tsx` uses.
